## Escalation Type

- [ ] Blocker — work cannot proceed
- [ ] Ambiguity — requirements are unclear
- [ ] Safety concern — patient safety or data privacy risk
- [ ] Dependency conflict — conflicting requirements between issues
- [ ] Accuracy concern — measurement reliability below threshold
- [ ] Claims boundary — unclear if a claim is within documentation-assist posture
